## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `76ffcc70b39be2581d4aaee20bdcb69ec9d0ba6c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (claim template `Container & model` line, 路径分叉 governed-face line), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS row 188, `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120), `hintCovers` in scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, AGENTS.md Prime Directives 13 and 14

Inputs read: card #25729 body and all seven comments (triage 6392235918, claim 6396126096, surface amendment 6396153804, seat-2 claim 6396193561 and yield 6396249639, os-dev-report 6396446257, re-posted claim 6396460178); PR #25780 body, file list (4 files, +33/−11) and net diff; the 58 check-runs on this head. Head unchanged at review time. PR is draft, auto-merge unarmed, labels `documentation` `size/s` `skip-changeset`, head repo = base repo.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Tier row — right.** `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOB_ROWS` gains `docs/adr/**` ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, `oneLineExit: false`, `why` quoting the order verbatim. The order 「adr 这种任务都需要 fable extra，重新处理并立skills 卡片」 is met on all three axes the card read out of it: ADR paths mandate the ceiling tier (TIER_CEILING is `tierWordOf(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)`, so "fable" resolves to this constant and no model id is written); 「都需要」 closes the one-line exit by path, the same data shape as the `skills/**` row; "extra" becomes the `xhigh` floor. The table's existing live guards (glob must name an existing path; two globs on one path must agree on tier) cover the new row, and the new row cannot conflict: `docs/adr/**` shares no path with the three existing globs.
2. **Table stays a copy of one predicate — right.** The docblock says the table is a machine-readable copy of clause ① of the skill's tiering policy and the skill wins on disagreement. The same PR rewrites clause ① in `execution-duties.md` to 「凡改协议语义面或 `docs/adr/**` 的卡一律契约复审档」, so the policy text and the four rows describe one predicate again (SKILL.md, os-dev.md, the frame-copy half via `check:skill-frame-sync` COPIES, `skills/**`, now `docs/adr/**`). The 协议语义面 definition line (L97) is deliberately NOT widened — ADR text is not protocol semantics, it is a separate disjunct — which keeps clause ② and the `references/**` wording untouched. Correct choice.
3. **Effort floor as skill text — right, with one honest limit.** 「后者 effort 下限 `xhigh`」 sits on the clause-① line where tier is chosen, and L118's effort table (`max` 凭维护者点名) is untouched, so `xhigh` is a floor difficulty can raise and never lower. The limit: no checker reads an `effort:` word against the surface (post-stamped's claim checker reads only the tier citation), so the floor is prose-enforced. That is the right side of the instrument freeze — a printed effort line or a claim-time refusal would be a new derivation line / gate, both barred without the maintainer's word on an instrument, and the order speaks to dispatching, not to a new instrument.
4. **`tierLines` wording — right, and inside the freeze's own exception.** Before: every `oneLineExit: false` hit printed "(the published catalog, 2026-09-10 ruling)" as its reason, so an ADR card would have printed the catalog's ruling — a 推导失真. After: the line points at the row's own `why` already on the hit line above. Existing line rewritten in place, no new line, no new constant, no new tier; the comment above is kept in step. The `skills/**` rendering still carries "no one-line exemption" and the catalog pins in the self-test still hold.
5. **Self-test — right.** The pin "every entry except `skills/**` keeps `oneLineExit` undefined" would have redded by construction; widening it to the two-glob `ONE_LINE_BARRED` roster keeps the opt-out-absent-by-default invariant for every other row. New cases pin: the row's shape; an ADR file mandated by that row alone (`hits.length === 1`); `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` and the prefix sibling `docs/adr-notes.md` NOT mandated (`hintCovers` is segment-bounded, pattern branch via `zeroSegmentForms`/`triggerCovers`, so a string prefix is not an ancestor); the ADR rendering refuses the exit by name and does not borrow the catalog's reason. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (fast tier) is green on this head.
6. **Line budget on the ratchet — right.** `execution-duties.md` 188 → 188 against CEILINGS 188; the two rewritten lines measure 116 B and 110 B against `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120. The deleted words 「发布的」 and 「整根」 were descriptors, not a rule with no other home: the published fact survives as 「随 `npx skills add` 发运」 on the same line and in the `skills/**` row's `why`; "whole root" is what the glob `skills/**` spells. The `skills/**` no-one-line-exemption rule says exactly what it said (⛔ 无一行级豁免,逐行判机械不作数). No ruled clause deleted.
7. **Instrument freeze on `dispatch-gates.mjs` — right side.** Item 1 is a data row in `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` mandating the EXISTING constant; item 4 is the freeze's own 推导失真 exception; no gate, derivation line, ratchet or constant is added. On the reading question see ③.
8. **Clean against #25745.** That PR's hunks on `dispatch-gates.mjs` (L12663, `discoverFamiliesPass` comment) and the self-test (L659, L1003, L2800, L8442) are textually disjoint from this PR's (L12115 and L9999); ordinary concurrency, later lander merges `origin/main`. `mergeable_state` is clean.
9. **Check-runs on the head — all gate verdicts green.** `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (and all 8 shards), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `…same single-writer path`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card` — success. `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`: the first run (121140541228) was failure because seat 2's later claim was newest; after yield 6396249639 and the re-posted claim 6396460178 naming `claude/project-thread-biervl`, the latest run (121142729841) is success — judged on its latest run. `Build Core`, `Console Pin Gate`, UI jobs, dogfood matrix, Temporal: skipped by path filter (no code package touched). Nothing in_progress.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — correct. `Metadata-protocol: none` — correct: nothing a metadata author can write changes. The diff is `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`; neither path is inside a released package, so `skip-changeset` is the right label and `Check Changeset` confirms it. No BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 disposition owed. Rules change only (dispatch tiering policy); it refuses no PR and adds no required check, as triage graded it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation (file surface widened mid-run to `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` and the `tierLines` wording) — accepted.** Recorded by the seat in amendment 6396153804 before the push; the self-test widening was forced by construction and the `tierLines` edit is the freeze exception above. Both named in the os-dev-report `deviations`.
- **Deviation (ran the self-test module directly first, measured nothing) — accepted, no residue.** Discarded and replaced by `dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` (2182 cases, both tiers, per the report).
- **Open question 1 (does a new path row count as a new `--tier` 强制档 under instrument-discipline L10?) — answered: reading A, and the row stands.** The freeze bars a new 强制档 on the instrument; a new path mandating the existing tier is a mandate the instrument did not print before, so the strict reading applies. The freeze's own L5 opens an addition that quotes the maintainer verbatim on the card; the card quotes 「adr 这种任务都需要 fable extra」 verbatim, dated, with speaker, and the row's `why` repeats it. The order post-dates the freeze and demands exactly this mandate. Under this review the row is admitted on the order's word; whether the order is also the word that LANDS a tiering change is the maintainer's — the PR body's 维护者速读 already asks, and the seat's own claim says the landing waits for the maintainer's go-ahead. ⛔ This record is the Tier S review of record; it does not substitute for that go-ahead where the seat has asked for it.
- **Open question 2 (`max` stays 凭维护者点名) — answered: A, keep.** The order says "extra" (xhigh), not `max`; opening `max` by difficulty would edit a separate ruled line (L118) the order never named. The floor raises the minimum only. If 田騏 meant `max` by "extra", that is a one-word correction for the maintainer on this PR, not a defect in the diff.
- **Open question 3 (overlap with #25745) — answered: A, ordinary concurrency**, textually disjoint hunks (judgment 8).
- **Flag, not a FAIL: the quota and low-headroom exits remain open to ADR cards.** 「都需要」 closes the one-line judgment exit by path; the measured quota exemption (tier EXHAUSTED ⇒ default, never lower) and the proactive low-headroom downgrade are claim-time measurements, not judgments, and the 2026-09-10 `skills/**` ruling left them open the same way. Consistent with precedent; the maintainer may narrow further by word.
- **Flag, not a FAIL: the effort floor has no mechanical reader** (judgment 3). By design under the freeze; the compensating control is the at-tier review of the claim comment's `Container & model` line, which already prints `effort:`.
- **Second half of the order 「重新处理并立skills 卡片」:** this card IS the skills card; re-drafting #25403/#25717 at tier is #25403's own question (card Boundary, triage). Out of scope here, correctly.
- **Acceptance-note residue (`references/lanes/spec.md` L25 stale pointer to 「SKILL.md 模型分档」):** correctly left as a note, not a defect class.
- **Landing:** Tier S (`.claude/**` only; `scripts/pm/**` is the skills lane's own). On this PASS the owning seat may ready and queue it per PD 14 — subject to the maintainer's go-ahead the seat itself asked for above. No agent approving review is to be submitted.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-biervl`
Reviewed-by: `session_014FZ3TJucS1L7BdMe5DAzXC`

**VERDICT: PASS**
